name: Torek's Assault
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hey!  Champion!  Come here!

My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west.  Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire.  Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors.  The battle will be glorious!

Do you want to share in the glory, adventurer, and aid us?  If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.

What do you say.  Are you with us?
narrative.objectives: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, adventurer. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...

And I hope you gained a scar or two!
narrative.requestItemsText: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?
